thi-ap32:1.2: brāhmaññakulasambhavā → brahmaññakulasamhavā (bj) | brāhmaññakulasambhavā → brāhmaṇakulasambhavā (cck: syā. ka.)
thi-ap32:3.2: bahū → hū (cck) | sabbadassāvino → saccadassāvino (cck: sī. pī.)
thi-ap32:4.3: tumhaṁ → tvayi (bj) | Tumhaṁ → tvayi (cck: sī. pī.)
thi-ap32:5.2: brāhmaññakulasambhavā → brahmaññakulasamhavā (bj) | brāhmaññakulasambhavā pekkhato no → brahmaññakulasambhavā lakkhaṇā ca (sya-all)
thi-ap32:8.4: anujānātha → anujānimha (sya-all) | anujānātha → anujānimha (cck: syā. pī. ka.)
thi-ap32:11.1: candasūriye sāgarañca → candasuriye sāgaraṁ ca (bj) | candasūriye → candasuriye (sya-all)
thi-ap32:12.3: tusitaṁ nimmite deve → tussitā nimmitā devā (sya-all)
thi-ap32:23.2: jaṭilo → jajjiyo (sya-all) | raṭṭhiko oruddhe → raṭṭhako oratīre (sya-all)
thi-ap32:25.3: setuṁ vihārañca → secuvihāre ca (bj) | vihārañca → vihāraṁ ca (sya-all) | ca → tesu setuvihāresu (bj: sīmu) | vihārañca → tesu setuvihāresu (cck: sī.); tassa setū vihāre ca (cck: pī.)
thi-ap32:28.2: kadalīpuṇṇaghaṭe dhaje → kadalīpuṇṇaghaṭaddhajā (sya-all) | dhaje → suṇṇakuṭadadhajā (bj: PTS); puṇṇaghaṭā dhajā (bj: machasaṁ)
thi-ap32:28.3: cuṇṇañca mālañca → cuṇṇaṁ ca mālaṁ ca (bj) | ca → dhūmacuṇṇañca (bj: PTS)
thi-ap32:30.3: anumodanīyaṅkāsi → anumodaniyaṁkāsi (bj) | anumodanīyaṅkāsi jaṭilassa → anumodaniyaṁ katvā byākāsi (sya-all)
thi-ap32:32.1: kāci → ye keci (bj) | kāci hatthaparikammaṁ → ye keci hatthakammañca (sya-all)
thi-ap32:33.3: uppannā → upapannā (bj) | devabhavanaṁ tuyhaṁ tā → devabhavane tuyhante (sya-all)
thi-ap32:34.3: tuyhaṁ te paricārema saṁsarimha → anubhonti ciraṁ kālaṁ saṁsaritvā (sya-all)
thi-ap32:36.2: kittiñca → kittiṁ ca (bj) | kittiñca sakkataṁ → kittisukhaṁ piyaṁ (sya-all) | sakkataṁ → kittisukhaṁ piyaṁ (cck: syā.)
thi-ap32:38.2: passāma na laṅkataṁ cikkhallabhūmimasuciṁ → passāmanalaṅkataṁ cīkkhallabhūmimasuciṁ (bj) | na laṅkataṁ cikkhallabhūmimasuciṁ → nalaṅkataṁ cikkhallaṁ bhūmiṁ gamanaṁ (sya-all)
thi-ap32:39.4: pubbakammaphalena → pubbakammabalena (bj) | no → pubbakammaphalaṁ tato (cck: sī. pī.)
thi-ap32:40.4: bhavāmase → natthi dāni punabbhavo (cck: sī. syā. pī.)
